functions.docs:
@return true if this spawner is used in the editor, or false if it is purely runtime. We use this to prioritize the
use of editor spawners when in editor

functions.name: GetSpawnerPriority
functions.docs:
@return Spawner priority in order to sort the list of the spawners. If several spawners
match the template type, the one with the highest priority will be picked.
